slides.title: African party summit opens in Addis Ababa
Party leaders gather
slides.body: Ethiopian state media says party leaders and heads of state are attending.

slides.title: Hosted by Prosperity Party
slides.body: Ethiopia's ruling party hosts it with the African Governance Center, to Nov 7.

slides.title: What is planned
slides.body: Talks on jobs and trade. An "Addis Ababa Declaration" is to be adopted. Single state-media source.

slides.title: Open dialogue for every citizen.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: ENA (state media) via allAfrica · Nov 5, 2026
